review.resultAssessment: BRO won 24-10, a 14-kill margin; KRX +7.5 lost by 6.5 adjusted kills.
review.processAssessment: The model overestimated KRX's ability to convert engage into sustained damage and underweighted BRO's player-strength and lead-conversion edge. Jhin also limited sustained damage in extended fights, while BRO had multiple reliable damage sources and initiation paths.
review.calibrationAction: Do not recommend an underdog positive kill handicap from engage access alone. Require two credible sustained damage sources, item parity, frontline kill speed and observed conversion. Enforce the 0.25u cap without exception.
